name: Buhi! Onna Kishi Nanka ni Makenai Buhi! ~Hime-sama Elf no Orc Ijiri~
original_name: ブヒィ！女騎士なんかに負けないぶひぃ！～姫様エルフのオーク弄り～
source:
Long ago, orcs trampled over elves.  
But times have changed. Now, it’s the elves who dominate the orcs—both for entertainment and reproduction.  

One day, an unlucky orc is captured by an elven princess.  
But this orc is different from the others.  

He dreams of reviving the old world, where orcs ruled over elves—a world he’d only heard about in fairy tales.  
Seeing this as his chance, he schemes to win over the princess, who’s likely to toy with him, and use her as a stepping stone to take his first step toward that goal.  

Will the orc achieve his dream…?  
Or will he fade away like the others, just another plaything for the elves…?  

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ012600.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，兽人践踏精灵。
但时代改变了。如今，精灵为了娱乐与繁衍支配着兽人。

某天，一名倒霉兽人被精灵公主抓住。
可这个兽人与其他兽人不同。

他梦想复兴兽人统治精灵的旧世界——那是他只在童话里听说过的世界。看见这次机会，他设计赢得可能会玩弄自己的公主，把她当作踏脚石，迈出实现目标的第一步。

兽人能实现梦想吗？
还是会像其他兽人一样消失，成为精灵的另一个玩物？

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ012600.html/]DLsite[/url]]
